diagnosed_skill_and_repair.overall_diagnosis: The agent's OCR pipeline passed 43/44 checks (reward 0.977). The sole failure is receipt 039.jpg (test_receipt_06_date): date extraction returned an incorrect/missing ISO date despite the amount being correct. Image 039.jpg (shown as the 7th image, the Perniagaan Zheng Hui receipt) has the date 'Date: 09/03/2018' near 'Receipt #' and 'Cashier: USER'. The pipeline's date voting across OCR variants likely picked up a different date-like token (e.g., GA1801 handwritten annotations or misread of the slash) or failed to parse the format reliably on this slightly noisy scan. The image-ocr skill (which drives OCR extraction and date parsing heuristics) is the relevant skill to repair; other skills (xlsx output format, openai-vision, pdf, video) are not implicated.

skills.diagnosis: Date extraction heuristic fails on 039.jpg (Perniagaan Zheng Hui receipt). The receipt clearly shows 'Date: 09/03/2018' adjacent to 'Receipt #: CS00084670' and 'Cashier: USER', with handwritten 'GA1801'/'GB1801' annotations next to each line item that can mislead date voting. The skill likely either (a) picks a non-date numeric token biased by handwritten '1801' tokens, (b) fails to anchor to the 'Date:' label when it appears on the same line as a time, or (c) relies on majority voting across OCR variants where the degraded scan produces inconsistent reads of the slash separator.
skills.repair_instruction: Strengthen date extraction in image-ocr/SKILL.md: (1) Give strong priority to tokens on lines that explicitly contain 'Date', 'Tarikh', 'Dated', or 'Receipt' labels, over any voting from unlabeled numeric tokens. (2) Explicitly ignore handwritten-style short alphanumeric tokens like 'GA1801', 'GB1801', 'A03041' when scanning for dates (reject tokens with mixed leading letters). (3) When a label line contains both a date and a time (e.g., 'Date: 09/03/2018  Time: 08:49:00'), split on whitespace and parse the date substring independently. (4) Add a fallback: if the primary date vote has low confidence, re-run OCR on just the top-right header region (where 'Date:' typically appears on tax-invoice receipts) at higher DPI with PSM 6. (5) Add a sanity check that the extracted year is plausible (2015–2019 range for this dataset) to reject spurious matches like '1801'.
